Create a DICOM PACS Network Connection Specification

Source: R/network.R
dicom_connect.Rd

Creates a "dicom_connection" object holding PACS / DICOM node connection parameters for use with dicom_echo(), dicom_find(), dicom_get(), and dicom_send(). Supports both DIMSE TCP connections and DICOMweb (QIDO-RS / WADO-RS / STOW-RS) HTTP endpoints.

Usage

dicom_connect(
  host = "127.0.0.1",
  port = 104L,
  called_ae = "ANY-SCP",
  calling_ae = "DICOMTK",
  timeout_ms = 5000L,
  dicomweb_url = NULL,
  local_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

host

Hostname or IP address of the remote DICOM peer (e.g., "127.0.0.1" or "https://pacs.example.org/dicom-web").

port

Integer TCP port for DIMSE communication. Default is 104L (or 4242L for Orthanc).

called_ae

Remote Application Entity Title (Called AET). Default is "ANY-SCP".

calling_ae

Local Application Entity Title (Calling AET). Default is "DICOMTK".

timeout_ms

Socket timeout in milliseconds. Default is 5000L.

dicomweb_url

Optional base URL for DICOMweb (QIDO-RS / WADO-RS / STOW-RS) REST APIs.

local_dir

Optional local directory path to act as a local file-backed PACS repository for testing queries and retrievals offline.

Value

An S3 object of class "dicom_connection".

Examples

conn <- dicom_connect("127.0.0.1", port = 4242, called_ae = "ORTHANC")
conn
#> ℹ DICOM Connection: DICOMTK -> ORTHANC@127.0.0.1:4242
